engine: r1864's /location announce — a POI MAP that DIMS (opacity 1 -> ~0.3) + pushes back (scale 1 -> 1.04) to become a dark BACKDROP as the section enters, while a giant serif HEADLINE + sub rise over it and a RAIL of N location CARDS (photo + caption-under) STAGGERS in from below; a circular -> arrow scrolls the rail (finite, clamped at the ends; loop optional). On leave-back the carousel collapses and the map RECLAIMS full opacity. The 'look where this sits' chapter, laid over a living map. Designed to compose OVER river-tinted-poi-map (Brick 3) as the backdrop. Harvested from D_r1864 (r18641 /location 'ОДИН ИЗ САМЫХ ПРИВИЛЕГИРОВАННЫХ РАЙОНОВ СТОЛИЦЫ' + 5 cards over the dimmed map).

measured_teardown.move: TWO motions. A) ENTER (scroll-into-view scrub, p 0..1, PURE set(p)): map opacity 1->dimTo(0.3) + scale 1->1.04 over 0..0.5; headline fade + translateY 30->0 over 0.15..0.5; sub 0.30..0.6; cards stagger fade + translateY 40->0, each offset by cardStagger, over ~0.45..1.0; nav (prev + circular arrow) fades 0.7..1.0. ease power3.out per channel. owns_pin OPTIONAL (pin:true holds the map while the announce plays). B) ADVANCE (the -> arrow / .mdc-prev / dots): translateX the rail by one card-step (eased, not scroll), clamped at [0, maxIndex] (maxIndex = N - visibleCards) unless loop:true.
measured_teardown.cited: r18641 /location: the river-tinted POI map dims to a dark taupe backdrop; over it a giant serif 'ОДИН ИЗ САМЫХ ПРИВИЛЕГИРОВАННЫХ РАЙОНОВ СТОЛИЦЫ' + a 3-line sub, and a bottom rail of 5 cards (photo + caption-under: НАБЕРЕЖНАЯ МОСКВЫ-РЕКИ / ПАРК «ЗАРЯДЬЕ» / ГУМ / РЕПИНСКИЙ СКВЕР / ТРЕТЬЯКОВСКАЯ ГАЛЕРЕЯ) with a circular -> arrow at the right edge.

start.what: ScrollTrigger start for the enter announce.

dimTo.what: the map backdrop's dimmed opacity (1 = no dim).

mapScaleTo.what: the map's push-back scale as it dims (1 = no push).

cardStagger.what: per-card stagger fraction within the cards' window.

loop.what: false = finite rail clamped at the ends; true = wrap.

pin.what: pin the stage so the dimmed map holds while the announce plays.

once.what: play the enter once or reset on leave-back (map reclaims).

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when a shared page Lenis drives scroll.

entry: MapDimCarouselAnnounce.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), next(), prev(), go(i), refresh(), destroy }. target = .mdc-stage > .mdc-map (dimmable backdrop: SVG/img) + .mdc-overlay ( .mdc-headline + .mdc-sub + .mdc-rail-wrap ( .mdc-rail > .mdc-card[.mdc-card-img + .mdc-card-cap] x N ) + .mdc-nav( .mdc-prev + .mdc-arrow ) ). set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the ENTER; next/prev/go drive the rail.
law: opacity + transform (translate, scale) only; GPU; NO mix-blend OVER the map (would tank scroll perf); NO WebGL. The map backdrop is an / OR inline SVG (the lab embeds the river-tinted-poi-map SVG, Brick 3, so it is asset-independent + demonstrates the compose). reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (map dimmed, cards visible, rail scrolls native overflow-x). owns_pin OPTIONAL (default false: a scroll-into-view announce). GSAP+ScrollTrigger required for the scroll reveal; set(p) + next/prev standalone.
gate_mode: scroll-into-view announce (optionally pinned) + a finite card rail. Verify: on enter the map DIMS 1->0.3 + pushes back, the headline + sub rise, and the 5 cards stagger in from below; the circular arrow scrolls the rail (clamped at the ends, no runaway); leave-back -> map reclaims. Smoothness via the scroll path. NOTE: full-height section — to screenshot, scroll so the stage fills the frame; a mid-scrub frame shows the still-legible map backdrop.
proven: lab: the river-tinted POI map (parks/roads/POI glyphs Кремль/Храм Христа Спасителя/ГЭС-2/Третьяковская + street-name italics) dims to a backdrop while 'ОДИН ИЗ САМЫХ ПРИВИЛЕГИРОВАННЫХ РАЙОНОВ СТОЛИЦЫ' + sub rise and 6 location cards (photo + caption-under) stagger in; a circular <- / -> nav scrolls the rail. ENTER curve measured live (p / map-op / headline / sub / card1 / lastCard / nav): 0 / 1.00 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 -> 0.30 / 0.34 / 0.81 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 -> 0.50 / 0.30 / 1 / 0.96 / 0.33 / 0 / 0 -> 0.75 / 0.30 / 1 / 1 / 0.98 / 0.53 / 0.42 -> 1 / 0.30 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 1. ADVANCE: rail x 0 -> -265px (one card-step); CLAMP: hammering the arrow stops at maxIndex (6 cards, ~5 visible @1280 -> maxIndex 1; no runaway); prev returns to 0. Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, scroll-enter + advance + prev): 290 frames, 0.69% long frames -> PASS, even with the 141-element map SVG. NO mix-blend over the map (perf law). Map backdrop = the embedded river-tinted-poi-map (Brick 3); card photos = quadro renders (honest demo assets; engine takes any photos). Serif = Playfair Display (Didot/Bodoni class); ground = #2c2724.
